description: Temporary change of use of the west car park for a period of 3 years to an Electric Vehicle Charging Hub (Sui Generis), including minor associated alterations to the existing parking layout comprising the removal of barriers and alterations to existing kerbs within the west car park.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Time limit 
The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision. 
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004. 
Condition : 2 - In accordance with approved drawings and Documents 

The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with: 

Documents received 04/03/2026 
GSK-HTL-SW-00-DR-A-10000 Rev P4 (Site Location Plan � West Car Park) 
Documents received 30/06/2026 
TPHS-443-DR-003 Rev C (Proposed West Car Park Layout � with EV Charging Hub) 
  
Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission, a satisfactory standard of development is secured, and to allow the Local Planning Authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 3 - Car Parking and EV Charging Management Plan 

Prior to first operation of the development hereby approved, a Car Parking and EV Charging Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include the following: 
(a) details of measures proposed to restrict parking to the EV charging spaces and prohibit parking elsewhere; 
(b) details of the operation of any gates or barriers, wayfinding/signage arrangement, road marking, and any other road safety measures adopted on site; 
(c) details of how parking will be monitored and managed; 
(d) measures to ensure that all prospective occupiers are informed of the Parking Management Plan. The parking areas and access road(s) shall thereafter be managed in compliance with the approved details, unless the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority is obtained to secure any variation. 
  
Reason: To ensure the charging hub operates solely as EV charging infrastructure, protects highway safety and prevents misuse of charging bays. 
Condition : 4 - Accessible Parking Provision 

Prior to first operation of the development hereby approved, details of accessible charging bays shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved bays shall be provided before first use of the charging hub and retained thereafter. 
  
Reason: To comply with London Plan Policy T6 and ensure accessibility for disabled users. 
Condition : 5 - Servicing and Maintenance Management Plan 

Prior to use, a Maintenance Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include details of the measures proposed to maintain the EV charging infrastructure. 

Reason: To ensure highway safety is maintained and preserved. 
Condition : 6 - Construction Logistics Plan (CLP) 
No development shall commence until a Construction Logistics Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, in consultation with TfL. The Plan shall include: 
�	Construction vehicle routing; 
�	Delivery and servicing arrangements; 
�	Measures to protect pedestrian movements; 
�	Details demonstrating that the A4 carriageway and footway will remain unobstructed; 
�	Arrangements for contractor parking; 
�	Details of any scaffolding, hoarding or highway licences required. 
Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Plan. 

Reason: To ensure highway safety is maintained and to minimise disruption to the operation of the Transport for London Road Network. 
Condition : 7 - Construction and Operational Vehicle Management 

All vehicles associated with the construction and operation of the EV charging hub shall park, stop, load and unload only within locations lawfully available for such purposes and in accordance with any applicable parking, waiting and loading restrictions.

Reason: To ensure highway safety is maintained and preserved. 
Condition : 8 - Provision and Retention of EV Infrastructure 

The EV charging bays, charging equipment and associated infrastructure shown on the approved plans shall be provided prior to first use and thereafter retained and maintained for the duration of the permission. 

Reason: To ensure the provision of the approved EV charging infrastructure. 
Condition : 9 - The use hereby permitted shall cease three years from the date of first operation, and the land shall be restored to its former condition unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 
Reason: The permission is granted for a temporary period only, having regard to the pending comprehensive redevelopment of the wider site and to enable the Local Planning Authority to reassess the impacts of the use after the temporary period has expired.
